hypothesis: Question-named anatomical crops contain visual information but the frozen reader shows weak attribute readout. Test whether training-only region experience improves a reader without any query localization at primary evaluation. This does not advance the failed oracle locator configuration or claim learned autonomous skills.
training_data: All100 strictly mask-grounded English train questions on75train images from existing M0, not selected by model correctness. Full+additional second single-image exposure per question, both supervised by original train answer. A full/full, B full/correct region, C full/off-target same-size region. No validation images in training.
evaluation_data: Primary: all71 English vqa validation questions with one named anatomical target and appearance/shape/normality task under the original answer-independent M0 classifier,46images, regardless of mask availability. Retention:69 frozen pilot validation questions of Organ/Position/Size/Quantity. Regional secondary:19 mask-supported primary questions on13images. No test access. Validation has been observed before and remains development evidence.
adapter: language self-attention q/k/v/o LoRA rank16 alpha32 dropout0,biasnone; visual encoder and base weights frozen; paired arm initialization same seed; bf16 sdpa
objective: Mean answer-token CE within each two-view identical-answer pair, then equal mean over rows per update. Include EOS; mask prompt and padding. Fixed final4epochs,52updates/arm,800supervised image exposures/arm. No best-epoch selection.
inputs: Exactly one336x336 raw RGB padded canvas per exposure/query, same system/user format. No rendered annotation, target label, source case, procedure or gold in generation interface. Train targets enter supervised labels only.
evaluation_engine: Same local HF/PEFT backend for base and all6final adapters; independent from earlier SGLang. Greedy max64 tokens, no sampling, same saved schedule for all models. Base is reevaluated once for backend-matched causal comparisons; not a retry of prior responses.
metric: Unchanged normalized exact match. Average paired training seeds before10000-image-cluster bootstrap using selection_seed. Preserve every improvement/harm and all task/target/retention groups.

investment_gate.B_minus_A_full_primary: >=.10 mean,strictly positive each training seed,95percent image-cluster lower>0
investment_gate.visual_specific_interaction: (B_N-B_Blank)-(A_N-A_Blank)>0 mean and each seed,95percent lower>0; blank-only gain is not visual learning
investment_gate.retention: B_N-base_N>=0 mean and each seed on69 off-task questions,95percent image-cluster lower>=-.05

stops: No validation scoring during training, no early best-epoch choice, no prompt/LR/rank/data search. Stop at hard clock or storage guard; save last recoverable adapters. Failed gate closes this exact adaptation recipe.
limits: Small development data, unknown patient independence and clinical label validity. Training-only annotated crops are privileged experience construction, not a learned locator or full ViSkill trajectory/PPO.
public_boundary: Only source/config/counts/numeric evidence/report; no medical QA/gold/pixels/crops/raw generated outputs/full prompts/weights/adapters/recovery files/private paths/tokens.
